messages:
Alex: heads up — we're seeing inconsistent routing header shapes across SDKs that is breaking quota attribution in the console :eyes:
Mira: oh snap, what shapes? example payloads?
Alex: python client sends `route_hint: [\"priorityA\"]`, ts/go send `route_hint: \"priorityA\"`
Devon: confirmed, saw a big spike in 'unattributed' tokens on the dash yesterday, traced to a batch job using the go client :grimace:
Samir: can we normalize server-side? add a small shim that accepts both forms and canonicalizes to an array?
Liyah: +1 for shim short-term, but we need an SDK plan — downstream telemetry and quota logic expects array, so SDKs should converge 
Mira: agree. propose: 1) server shim for immediate fix 2) patch clients to emit array consistently 3) soft-deprecation notice in changelogs 4) canary rollout and telemetry check
Alex: sounds good. minimal steps:
```
# python (current)
{\"route_hint\": [\"priorityA\"]}
# ts/go (current)
{\"route_hint\": \"priorityA\"}
# canonical form we want
{\"route_hint\": [\"priorityA\"]}
```
Devon: timeline? I can land the shim in the proxy today, enable in canary, and flip to all traffic if no regressions 
Samir: SDK owners — can we get a patch for go + ts to normalize to array and emit a one-line migration warning in logs? maybe vX.Y.Z with a WARN on first use?
Mira: yep, python already emits array, so patch not needed there. I'll draft the Go/TS PR template and migration note.
Liyah: console folks — can you add a temporary filter on the dashboard to include both shapes so historical charts don't drop data during rollout? also add a telemetry tag `route_shape:migration-2026`
Alex: @deploy-bot can we schedule the shim canary for 2pm PT and route 5% to it?
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: proxy-shim-canary -> 2026-03-21 14:00 PT, 5% traffic. Release ID: r-49725-canary :partyparrot:
Devon: I'll watch logs and the 'unattributed' metric. If it drops to expected levels within 30m we proceed to 50%
Samir: SDK PRs: I'll open go/ts branches now, target release next week. Will include automated test that validates both input shapes are accepted by the gateway 
Mira: note for release notes: call out breaking-safe change, emphasize no user action required if using python, small update for go/ts.
Alex: thanks all. let's reconvene after canary (ping here when stable).
